## Data for the practical

[Go to the data download page](../../donnees/index-en.qmd) to download the dataset for your specialisation. Python and R use the same files. Keep the `data` folder alongside your notebook or practical document, as explained in the instructions.

## Python

Download the notebook in your preferred language, then open it in Jupyter Notebook.

- [Download the Python practical - Français (.ipynb)](fichiers/Session2_TP_Python_FR.ipynb){download="Session2_TP_Python_FR.ipynb"}
- [Download the Python practical - English (.ipynb)](fichiers/Session2_TP_Python_EN.ipynb){download="Session2_TP_Python_EN.ipynb"}

## R

Download the R Markdown document in your preferred language, then open it in RStudio.

- [Download the R practical - Français (.Rmd)](fichiers/Session2_TP_R_FR.Rmd){download="Session2_TP_R_FR.Rmd"}
- [Download the R practical - English (.Rmd)](fichiers/Session2_TP_R_EN.Rmd){download="Session2_TP_R_EN.Rmd"}

**Submit this practical on [Moodle](https://moodle.unige.ch/course/view.php?id=21845)**, using the submission area for Session 2, no later than **Wednesday 18 November 2026 (inclusive)**.

- For Python, upload your **completed `.ipynb` notebook, including your answers and saved cell outputs**.
- For R, upload your **completed `.Rmd` document, including your answers and code**.
